scripts.build: pnpm tokens:sync && pnpm consent:sync && pnpm --filter zement-web build
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm build && pnpm test
scripts.tienda:up: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/.env -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -p zement up -d
scripts.tienda:down: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/.env -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -p zement down
scripts.tienda:logs: docker compose --env-file infra/docker/.env -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -p zement logs --tail=80 prestashop
scripts.tienda:theme: docker exec zement-prestashop-1 sh -c 'php bin/console prestashop:theme:enable zement && php bin/console cache:clear && rm -rf themes/zement/assets/cache/* && chown -R www-data:www-data var config/themes'
scripts.tienda:home: docker cp apps/tienda/config/scripts/setup-home.php zement-prestashop-1:/tmp/setup-home.php && docker exec zement-prestashop-1 php /tmp/setup-home.php
scripts.tienda:footer: docker exec zement-prestashop-1 rm -rf /tmp/zement-config && docker cp apps/tienda/config zement-prestashop-1:/tmp/zement-config && docker exec zement-prestashop-1 php /tmp/zement-config/scripts/setup-footer.php
scripts.tienda:settings: docker exec zement-prestashop-1 rm -rf /tmp/zement-config && docker cp apps/tienda/config zement-prestashop-1:/tmp/zement-config && docker exec zement-prestashop-1 php /tmp/zement-config/scripts/setup-settings.php
scripts.tienda:commerce: python3 apps/tienda/catalog/scripts/build_commerce.py && docker exec zement-prestashop-1 rm -rf /tmp/zement-config && docker cp apps/tienda/config zement-prestashop-1:/tmp/zement-config && docker exec zement-prestashop-1 php /tmp/zement-config/scripts/setup-commerce.php
